article_title: Under-fives and pregnant women told to avoid runny eggs when eating out over salmonella risk

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: New food-safety advice for vulnerable people during a salmonella outbreak linked potentially to imported eggs used by caterers
A nationwide ban on selling every kind of egg in supermarkets
A campaign encouraging pregnant women to eat more raw eggs
A shortage of British eggs caused by restaurant closures
tasks.correct_answer: New food-safety advice for vulnerable people during a salmonella outbreak linked potentially to imported eggs used by caterers
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציגה אזהרת בטיחות חדשה לקבוצות פגיעות בעקבות התפרצות סלמונלה וקשר אפשרי לביצים מיובאות שבהן משתמשים עסקי מזון.

tasks.prompt: Which group is included in the FSA's warning?
options: Only professional chefs
Children under five
All healthy adults under 40
People who never eat in restaurants
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ה־FSA הזהיר ילדים מתחת לגיל חמש, בני יותר מ־65, נשים בהיריון ואנשים עם מצבים רפואיים מסוימים.

tasks.prompt: Where does the new caution mainly apply?
options: Only to eggs collected from home gardens
To every British Lion egg eaten at home
When eating out and the source or assurance status of the eggs may be unclear
Only to packaged cakes bought in supermarkets
tasks.correct_answer: When eating out and the source or assurance status of the eggs may be unclear
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הזהירות נדרשת בעיקר באכילה מחוץ לבית, כאשר הלקוח אינו בטוח אם הביצים נושאות סימון בטיחות מוכר.

tasks.prompt: What does “vulnerable” mean in the article?
options: More likely to suffer severe effects from an infection
Responsible for inspecting restaurants
Vaccinated against every strain of bacteria
Imported from another country
tasks.correct_answer: More likely to suffer severe effects from an infection
tasks.explanation_hebrew: vulnerable פירושו פגיע יותר — אדם שעלול לסבול ממחלה חמורה יותר במקרה של זיהום.

tasks.prompt: Which food may contain uncooked egg and is mentioned as something vulnerable diners should avoid when its safety is uncertain?
options: Boiled rice
Grilled vegetables
Fresh fruit salad
Freshly made mayonnaise
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מיונז טרי עשוי להכיל ביצה לא מבושלת, ולכן הוא נכלל לצד סופלה ורוטב הולנדז בהמלצת הזהירות.

tasks.prompt: What did the FSA say about well-cooked eggs from restaurants, cafés and takeaways?
options: They are safe to eat
They must all be recalled
They are safe only for chefs
They should be washed before serving
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ה־FSA הבהיר שביצים שבושלו היטב במסעדות, בתי קפה וטייק־אוויי בטוחות לאכילה.

tasks.prompt: Name two assurances or facts that make UK-produced eggs different from the possible source being investigated.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שתי נקודות עובדתיות מן הכתבה לגבי ביצים מתוצרת בריטניה או מקור ההתפרצות האפשרי.
expected_points: Investigators found no evidence that UK-produced eggs were affected
British Lion eggs come from salmonella-vaccinated flocks
The Laid in Britain scheme is another recognised assurance
Potential links were found to imported eggs used by food-service businesses
The definitive source had not yet been identified

tasks.prompt: Why is the advice stricter when a vulnerable person eats out than when they prepare assured eggs at home?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את ההבדל במידע הזמין על מקור הביצה וברמת הבישול.
expected_points: Diners may not know whether the eggs have the British Lion or Laid in Britain assurance
Imported eggs are a possible source under investigation
Restaurants and caterers were a focus of the investigation
Runny eggs may not reach a temperature high enough to reduce bacteria
At home, consumers can check the mark and cook eggs thoroughly

tasks.prompt: Summarise the outbreak, the groups at greater risk and the FSA's practical advice.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את ההתפרצות, קבוצות הסיכון וההבחנה בין ביצים נוזליות לביצים שבושלו היטב.
expected_points: Authorities are investigating a growing Salmonella Enteritidis outbreak
Possible links involve imported eggs used outside the home
Young children, older people, pregnant women and people with certain health conditions face greater risk
Vulnerable diners should avoid runny or uncooked eggs when assurance is uncertain
Well-cooked eggs are safe
UK assured eggs are not currently linked to the outbreak

tasks.prompt: Write a short notice a café could give vulnerable customers about egg dishes during the outbreak. Base it on the article and avoid claiming that every egg is unsafe.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לנסח הודעה ברורה ומאוזנת הכוללת עצה מעשית, קבוצות סיכון והבחנה בין ביצה לא מבושלת לביצה מבושלת היטב.
expected_points: Identify vulnerable groups
Warn about runny eggs or fresh foods containing uncooked egg
Offer a thoroughly cooked alternative
Mention assurance or traceable sourcing where appropriate
State that well-cooked eggs remain safe
Avoid saying all UK or supermarket eggs are contaminated
